labels.title: Add a label
labels.description: Labels allow to create aliases inside mx_hal_def.h file like '<label>_init', '<label>_deinit' and '<label>_gethandle'. These aliases can be used on application side.

actions.message: Name must be a valid C identifier: start with a letter or underscore, and contain only letters, digits, or underscores.

init_type.title: Resource initialization code generation
init_type.description: Pick whether the initialization code should be generated and automatically called at startup.

oneOf.title: Callable
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated and called in peripheral initialization.

oneOf.title: Generated
oneOf.description: Initialization code is generated but not called in peripheral initialization.

periph_clocks_init.title: Peripherals clock strategy
periph_clocks_init.description: Choose where the initialization code for peripheral clock sources is generated and called.

oneOf.title: Central
oneOf.description: One single function (mx_rcc_peripherals_clock_config) contains clock source configuration and activation for all peripherals. This function is automatically called at system global initialization (in mx_system_init).

oneOf.title: Controlled by peripherals
oneOf.description: One function per peripheral (mx_rcc_pppi_clock_config) contains the clock source configuration and activation for that peripheral. These functions are automatically called at peripheral initialization (in mx_pppi_init).

oneOf.title: Controlled by user
oneOf.description: One function per peripheral (mx_rcc_pppi_clock_config) is generated but not called. You must call this function before using the peripheral.

flash_latency.title: Flash latency wait states
flash_latency.description: Select the number of wait states required for the chosen system clock frequency. This ensures reliable flash memory access at different speeds.

actions.message: Increase value. The flash wait states must be at least the recommended value for the current system clock. Using a lower value can lead to system malfunction.
Decrease value. Using a non-optimal value can affect performances.

flash_programming_delay.title: Flash programming delay
flash_programming_delay.description: Select the flash programming delay value required for the chosen system clock frequency. This ensures reliable flash memory operations at different speeds.

actions.message: Increase value. The flash programming delay must be at least the recommended value for the current system clock. Using a lower value can lead to system malfunction.
Decrease value. Using a non-optimal value can affect performances.

oneOf.title: Bypass
oneOf.description: External analog clock on OSC_IN pin.

oneOf.title: Digital bypass
oneOf.description: External digital clock on OSC_IN pin.

drive_capability.title: Drive capability
drive_capability.description: Adjust the amplifier driving capability to ensure a stable oscillation.

enable_css.title: Clock Security System
enable_css.description: CSS detects LSE failures. In case of failure, no automatic system action is taken. You must handle corrective actions.

audio_clock.title: External audio clock
audio_clock.description: External kernel clock input for I2S.

irq_handler_generation.title: NMI IRQ handler generation
irq_handler_generation.description: HSE and LSE CSS failures are reported through NMI. Enabling this option generates the NMI IRQ handler in which you can manage the clock failure event. If both HSE and LSE CSS are enabled, only one NMI handler is generated to manage both failures.
